character.asimo.description: Esse lobo só quer se divertir. Sua experiência com o oculto elétrico o permite sobrecarregar armas
galleryMainMenu.envelope.asimo.descripti:
Harnessing his electric powers, Asimo jolts into Inflation Roulette claiming to "have some fun".

We don't know how he got here, and we totally have no connections with him, other than he's a wolf, he's the Manager's playtester for his stupid Friday Night Funkin' mod, and he's the winner of an art raffle to be added to the game as a character for the Example Addon.

Asimo is a guest character owned by WolfKylis.
